description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。

> 如果当前网络实例为跨账号网络实例，本参数必填。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs.

> If the network instance and the CEN instance belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts, this parameter is required.
The ID of the network instance.

description.zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the network instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

- **VPC**：表示专有网络实例。
- **VBR**：表示边界路由器实例。
description.en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**: a virtual private cloud (VPC)
*   **VBR**: a virtual border router (VBR)

description.zh:
路由条目的目标网段。

目标网段为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24。
description.en:
The destination CIDR block of the route.

Specify the value of this parameter in CIDR notation. Example: 192.168.10.0/24.
The ID of the route table configured on the network instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn delete-cen-child-instance-route-entry-to-cen --cen-id cen-7febra5nqj7jjh0000 --child-instance-id vpc-k1alm2jbuwibhxtx20000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id ap-southeast-5 --child-instance-ali-uid 1787100000000000 --route-table-id vtb-k1aa8ulqs39f86op80000 --destination-cidr-block 192.168.22.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
